headline: Skipping unneeded VCF decoding speeds population genomic variant computation
label: Variant Data Processing Efficiency
summary: Growing variant dataset sizes make full-file decoding and whole-genome CNV preprocessing costly, motivating selective-execution designs.
synthesis: The dominant thread is reducing the computational cost of processing large variant datasets. VariantFlow applies selective execution, decoding only the VCF fields a computation requires, and reports 1000 Genomes missingness computation 8x faster than VCFtools. gVCF2CNV, a Nextflow pipeline, converts gVCF files into Log R Ratio and B Allele Frequency signals for CNV callers such as PennCNV and QuantiSNP and is described as scalable. What is new is the emphasis on field-level selectivity, skipping unnecessary decoding rather than only accelerating full computation. The rare-disease gene-prioritisation benchmark with HPO overlap flags and a version-pinned PMC hybrid retrieval index is a separate resource and does not share this algorithmic thread. Reported performance figures are as stated in item summaries; full manuscripts are required for validation.
